note: Bangladesh: no foreign national may work without a work permit (the Prime Minister's Principal Secretary at the Bangladesh Investment Development Authority, 2024), those coming on tourist or business visas included. The performer's entry visa category isn't modelled apart. No days without the permit.

sources.title: United News of Bangladesh, No foreign nationals to be allowed to work without work permit (2024)
sources.said: Prime Minister's Principal Secretary Md Tofazzel Hossain Miah said that no foreign nationals will be allowed to work in Bangladesh without a work permit.
